lines.t: Wanderin' through the ash and dry terrain Chasin' a ghost thirsty for the rain
You found the hidden chamber in my chest A secret place you carved for holy rest
Cold as the winter, waiting for a spark
Then came a shimmer, cutting through the dark
Blood in my veins, salt upon my skin
You count every tear where the healing begins
Drawn from your side when the veil was torn
Into the light where the bright is reborn
It's not in the roar, it's not in the storm
It's the silent floodin', keepin' me warm
Cascading down, through the depths of my soul
There's still a small voice that makes me whole
To the world outside, it's a rushin' tide
But it's pure, sweet peace
Peace on the inside
Look, you're searching high for a sun in the clouds
Trying to measure infinity, chasing the crowds
How does the water taste when you're dying in the sand?
How do you hold the uncreated in your hand?
He wrote my name before the earth had a spin
Loved me on the cross before the breath in my lungs began
No stolen title, no enemy threat
Can take what was promised, don't make him forget
He took a blank canvas, spoke through the dust
Turned every broken piece into holy trust
It's the voice of truth when the silence falls
The quietest whisper that breaks down walls
And your arms, earth passes away
Heaven and time fade into grey
Can you hold the infinite?
Can you hear the quiet?
Listen, listen, listen
It's not in the storm
It's not in the storm
Keeping me warm
Cascading down
Making me whole
It's not in the storm
To the world outside
Rushing time
Pure, sweet peace
On the inside
The voice of truth
The flame brought forth from glory
Darkness can cover, no shadow remains
The still, small voice
In the quiet, I hear you
